research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen official occupations, current indexed APH biography, full first speech, public professional profile index, historical Estimates staff listing, indexed government leave disclosure and archived first-party student club history reviewed. No roster change.

Unresolved early/private career leads: older Wikipedia text cites Libby Bingham, The Natural Politician, The Advocate, 25 November 2017, https://www.theadvocate.com.au/story/5076016/political-poster-boy/ for teenage KFC work and a family childcare centre reportedly started in 2016. Original returned (402) Payment Required. Neither exact employer/franchise nor dates/hours nor personal operational role could be confirmed from an accessible primary source. Retain leads, not assumed paid spells or zero private experience.

Childcare searches found unrelated Sarah/ Mae Duniam educators and general political statements; no matched employer identified. A third-party education advisory profile also mentions a family centre but provides no legal entity or dates; it misstates other staffing titles and is not used as proof. Follow up historical declared business interests and legitimate centre records.

Leave disclosure URL returned 404; indexed response establishes paid and unpaid leave but OCR table is incomplete. Seek relocated government release or contemporaneous Estimates attachment before entering separate unpaid intervals. Mercury 29 June 2016 article https://www.themercury.com.au/news/politics/goverment-and-opposition-defend-campaigning-former-staffers/news-story/1a83e7cd4ac8d7fed2f69d20bc8d075a presented No Cookies page; reported May resignation remains a lead, year endpoint retained.

Live UTAS Liberal history inaccessible; a legitimately public 2019 archived first-party page resolved presidency year. No inference that governance or student political activity was paid. Third-party 2006 graduation lead needs university corroboration.

Need pre-2003 work/study history, KFC dates/hours, childcare business identity and actual work, exact paid staffing transitions and leave dates. No full-time evidence established. Exhausted broad repeated KFC/childcare searches recorded; next follow-up should use source-specific employer, interests or archive leads.

Follow-up2026-10-02: historical interests transcription locates a new voluntary Tasmanian Wool Centre board lead, recorded as updated20June2017, which is not a commencement date. Original APHPDF link returned Failed to fetch restricted URL. Retain as lead until original declaration or centre board record is accessible; do not add income/investment entries as employment.

Relocated DPAC disclosure catalogue confirms7September2016leave release and1.2MBattachment. Reader click returned Unable to resolve click call due to invalid arguments; direct catalogue retrieval403. Earlier indexed table remains insufficient to allocate paid/unpaid dates. Newly identified Mercury TasWeekend profile repeats childcare-business lead but direct page is NoCookies; legal employer/operational role still unknown. No material employment fact established this pass; excluded from enrichment count.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: the official 45th Parliament handbook resolves degree completion to 2006, leaving commencement and study intensity unknown. The contemporaneous 28 May 2016 Mercury profile's indexed text confirms that Duniam and his wife started a childcare centre, but it does not establish his paid work, employer entity, hours or exact dates, so no employment spell was created. Targeted resignation searches repeated a May 2016 secondary claim but did not expose a reliable exact day or the underlying leave table; the political-staff endpoint remains year-only.

Existing indexed table OCR is ambiguous and does not separate leave types, so no dates or paid-days calculation promoted. Childcare policy articles concern sector policy, not his own business; prior2016reported cofounding remains a lead without paid-role proof.
